# Haggai Chapter 2 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A) | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/HAG_002_page_001.jpg

---

**2:6** "For thus says YHWH of-Hosts: Yet once [achat] — it [is] a-little-while [me'at hi] — and-I [am] shaking [mar'ish] the-heavens and-the-earth and-the-sea and-the-dry-land."

**2:9** "'The-latter [ha-acharon] glory [kevod] of-this house [ha-bayit ha-zeh] will-be greater [gadol yihyeh] than-the-former [ha-rishon],' says YHWH of-Hosts; 'and-in-this place [ba-maqom ha-zeh] I-will-give [etten] peace [shalom],' declares YHWH of-Hosts.
